canonical_project: Amazon Montgomery City Data Center Campus

location.site_area: Project Green / New Florence area, northeast quadrant of the I-70 and Highway 19 interchange; local reporting also references Hudson Road and Ellis Road.

why_not_in_baseline: Not present in the 208 baseline canonical_project list; separate from baseline Project Spade/New Florence-area Missouri record based on owner and public Amazon announcement.
contradictions: Project naming/location varies by source: Missouri Governor describes a Montgomery City campus, while county materials and industry/local reporting identify Project Green near New Florence at the I-70/Highway 19 interchange.

No official campus MW capacity was found. Cleanview lists 75 MW for individual AWS Project Green buildings, but this refresh leaves campus capacity_mw null pending official or utility-scale confirmation.
